notes.title: Patch Notes - April 23
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone for your amazing continued support for Egression! We've got a few tweaks that went out in this last patch, plus if you jump in-game you'll notice some coming soon content - details below!

[h3]Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made improvements to distance grab - in particular, this will execute the grab slightly more quickly now, which should make the interaction feel a bit more natural
[*] Made improvements to how keys and locks interact, especially when using distance grab
[*] Fixed an issue with floor height unintentionally resetting when returning from out of bounds
[*] Fixed an issue where fuses would fall through floors if thrown just right
[/list]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added several "coming soon" items in the lobby, with some hints at what exactly is coming soon (*cough* another round of puzzles *cough*) - check them out, get excited, and stay tuned for more coming this summer!
[/list]

As usual, if you have any feedback on Egression, or just want to chat about puzzles, please [url=https://discord.gg/m6J5WcjjB6]join us on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Patch Notes - November 19
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has given amazing feedback on Egression so far! Our first patch is now out the door - see the release notes below for details!

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for [b]distance grab[/b] to pick up items from the floor without bending down (with an option to distance grab from non-floor locations for sitting players or limited play spaces)
[*] Added a button to the Tablet's exit screen to [b]reset progress[/b] (great for letting friends/family start playing from scratch!)
[*] Added a [b]confirmation screen for graphics quality changes[/b] (previously, players could inadvertently make the game unplayable at too high a setting, and then be unable to change it back)
[*] Added [b]automatic graphics quality adjustments[/b] when framerate is consistently poor (to keep the game in a playable state)
[*] [b]Increased allowed floor offsets[/b] for extreme cases and to allow young/small or sitting players to reach higher (combine this with the new distance grab feature to avoid needing to change floor height constantly)
[*] Added a [b]deadzone for locomotion controls[/b] for aging controllers (no more drift!)
[/list]

[h3]Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an [b]instructional sign behind the tablet[/b] on the intro table, to let players know not to try to put the tablet back in its holder (press the appropriate button on your control to put the tablet away and take it back out)
[*] Added a [b]splash of fall[/b] to the kiosk area (gourds and turkeys galore)
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a hand could disappear until the tablet is used
[*] Fixed an issue where the player’s view would jump when using Pimax headsets
[/list]

If you have any feedback on your play experience, please feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/m6J5WcjjB6]join us on Discord[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: Official Egression Release Date!
notes.notes:
The big day is fast approaching! After two years of development, Egression will finally become available to play on [b]October 12th[/b]. And to save you the time of checking your calendar, that's [i]only two weeks away[/i]!

We are super excited to finally get Egression into your hands! This has been the journey of a lifetime for our team, and we can't wait to share it with you.

And don't forget - if you've got puzzle-loving friends who could use a good VR escape room or two in their lives, now's as good a time as any to make sure they know about Egression!
